title: feat: add shared email support skill
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added a shared email-support skill for Claude and Codex. It guides agents to investigate against production evidence and review one case at a time. An approved C-design HTML example provides a copyable template; agents compose HTML and plain text directly and generate local previews with a complete English switch, without a custom renderer or JSON format. The guidance documents sender identity, mailbox coverage, and the shared Workspace footer without duplicating branding. Workspace configuration is unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art workspace, Polli reviews one email beside a small code-plant and a lime green (#ecf874) glowing monitor; she wears tiny reading glasses. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream and pastel background.
